game: Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix
project: Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix PC Port
approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 XBLA version to native PC code using ReXGlue
notes: Public native PC release with Windows and experimental Linux/Steam Deck builds, TRG launcher, rendering up to 4x resolution, local saves and achievements, Xbox controller and keyboard support, and the original 60 FPS gameplay
